references.text: Describes cities built on mounds (tells), which was a common construction style in ancient Canaan
Jericho was burned with fire, one of the few cities that were completely destroyed by fire
Ai was burned by Joshua, another city that was destroyed by fire like Hazor
Describes the conquest of Hazor and how Joshua struck the king with a sword and burned the city
Hazor is mentioned as an important city in connection with Jabin, king of the Canaanites
Solomon rebuilt Hazor again, which shows the city's strategic importance
Earlier conquest of Canaanite cities under Moses' leadership, as a precursor to Joshua's conquests
